Case study: Event Booking System

Odoo 19 Community, client project. Four connected modules, from requirements to handover.

Booking requestBooking StudioDeposit invoiceCheck-inFinal invoiceInsights
4connected modules
52manual test cases

Watch the demo (90 seconds)

A walkthrough of the Event Booking System, from venue selection to check-in and reports. Captions show each step. It has a soft background track and no narration, so press play at a comfortable volume.

The problem

Event teams need one place to plan venues, take bookings, track payments and see how events are doing, instead of juggling separate sheets.

What I built

A core booking module (Booking Studio, venues and seating, pipeline, payments, check-in, dashboard, PDF report), Invoicing (deposit and final invoices linked to Accounting), Insights (money overview, overdue payments, daily sheet) and a Smart Assistant that reads a typed booking request and suggests free dates, offline. I wrote the requirement and design documents, the tests and the user guide.

PythonXMLQWebOWLSCSSPostgreSQLAccounting

BizPulse

Odoo 19 Community suite of eight modules (2026). Sales has discount approvals, targets and commission rules. CRM has explainable lead scoring, a next best action and capacity-aware lead assignment. HR has attendance insights and an availability helper. An OWL dashboard with Chart.js shows KPIs by access level, and one wizard produces seven reports as PDF or Excel. An AI assistant answers questions in plain language and sends a morning briefing, through a gateway that supports Ollama, Gemini and Groq. The AI only suggests, users confirm, and every call is logged. Test cases and a user guide are included.

PythonXMLQWebOWLChart.jsPostgreSQLAI connector

Student and Course Management

One module for students, courses, batches, enrollments, marks and fees. Four wizards (enrollment, fee collection, promotion, messaging) and five PDF reports (marksheets, admission confirmation, fee receipts, ID cards, course lists). Test cases and a user guide are included.

Training Center and Library

Two practice modules on Odoo 19: courses, trainers, students and a discount wizard, plus books, authors, categories and tags. Also an ORM assignment covering create, write, browse, search, unlink and validations. Test cases and a user guide are included.
